e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.definition: A body of ideas about how conflict works, built from the study of past campaigns rather than from rules of fighting.
e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.gloss: A body of ideas about how conflict works, built from the study of past campaigns rather than from rules of fighting.

e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.definition: 戦闘方法に関する規則ではなく、戦争がどのように進むかをstudy based on past campaigns.
e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.gloss: 過去の戦争の研究に基づいて、戦争や武力対立のしくみを説明する理論。

e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.definition: 전쟁 이론은 전쟁의 구조와 과정을 설명하는 생각들의 모음으로, 과거 전쟁과 군사 원정에 대한 연구에 근거한다. 구체적으로 싸우는 방법만을 제시하는 실전 지침과는 다르다.
e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.gloss: 전쟁이 어떻게 전개되는지에 관한 여러 생각을 종합한 체계.

e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.definition: Corpo de conceitos que explica como as guerras funcionam, baseado no estudo de campanhas e conflitos históricos. Analisa os princípios gerais da guerra, diferentemente das táticas usadas em um combate específico.
e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.gloss: Conjunto de ideias sobre a natureza e o desenvolvimento das guerras.

e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.definition: Teori perang adalah kumpulan gagasan tentang cara kerja konflik yang disusun berdasarkan kajian terhadap kampanye-kampanye masa lalu, bukan sekadar aturan bertempur.Teori ini tidak khusus memberikan cara bertempur, tetapi menjelaskan mengapa dan bagaimana konflik berlangsung.
e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.gloss: Kumpulan gagasan tentang cara kerja konflik yang disusun melalui kajian kampanye masa lalu.

e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.definition: ชุดแนวคิดที่อธิบายการดำเนินไปของความขัดแย้งและสงคราม พัฒนาจากการศึกษายุทธการในอดีตมากกว่าจากกฎการต่อสู้โดยตรง
e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.gloss: ชุดแนวคิดเกี่ยวกับการทำงานและการเปลี่ยนแปลงของสงคราม

e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.definition: Savaşların nasıl gerçekleştiğini ve çatışmaların nedenlerini açıklayan bilimsel bir yaklaşımdır. Geçmiş seferlerin ve savaşların incelenmesinden yararlanır; tek tek dövüş kurallarından oluşan bir çatışma yöntemi değildir.
e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.gloss: Savaş kuramı, çatışmaların işleyişini açıklayan ve geçmiş savaşların incelenmesine dayanan düşünceler bütünüdür.

e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.translation: Bu kitap, çatışmanın nasıl işlediğini açıkladığı için savaş kuramı olarak adlandırılır.
หนังสือเล่มนี้เรียกว่าทฤษฎีการสงครามเพราะอธิบายว่าความขัดแย้งดำเนินไปอย่างไร มิใช่สอนวิธีต่อสู้
Buku itu diberi judul teori perang karena membahas cara kerja konflik, bukan cara bertempur.
A obra apresenta uma teoria da guerra ao discutir os princípios e as relações entre os conflitos armados.
이 책은 전쟁 이론이라 불리는 이유는 싸우는 방법이 아니라 갈등이 전개되는 방식에 관한 연구이기 때문이다.
その本は、戦争の打法ではなく、戦争がどのように機能するかを説明しているので戦争理論と呼ばれている。

e20a5a90c408a242bd6f3709a543345e1ac318f4.text: The book is called a theory of war because it explains how conflict works, not how to fight.
